descriptions.zh:
### 接口说明
请求语法中Host由Project名称和日志服务Endpoint构成，您需要在Host中指定Project。
descriptions.en:
### Operation description
The Host in the request syntax consists of the project name and the Simple Log Service endpoint. You must specify the project in the Host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls get-project --project ali-project-test --cross-region true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET / --project ali-project-test --region cn-hangzhou --crossRegion true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
